requirements.note: Blue right / grey left bubbles, oldest at top, centred date headings ('Sep 26, 2026 at 4:08 PM', 'Today at 12:53 AM') at day changes; opens at newest message.
Send appends the bubble, stays at bottom, composer clears; send disabled when empty or whitespace-only.
Composer rides above keyboard; newest messages stay visible above it.
'Sam is typing…' row with dots plus 'typing…' subtitle under the nav title; reply ('👍', 'Sounds good!') arrives ~2 s later.
Context menu with Copy/Delete works (copy pasted correctly, delete removes and persists), but the lifted preview is a blank white pill with no text or colour.
Flings all the way to the first message (Jul 1); a round chevron 'Jump to newest message' button appears and returns to the bottom.
Sent messages, Sam's replies and deletions survive relaunch.

bugs: Long-press context menu preview renders as an empty white rounded rectangle instead of the message bubble.
tells: Navigation bar has no material/scroll-edge effect: content is hard-clipped under the title bar and above the composer rather than blurring under bars as iOS 26+ does.
Send button sits inside the composer as a flat grey pill rather than a system glass/filled circular button; composer border looks hand-drawn.
Emoji-only messages are shown inside a normal bubble rather than as large standalone emoji like Messages.
Scroll indicator's page count drifts (26 → 39 pages) while scrolling, suggesting estimated row heights; indicator jumps.
Bubbles have no tails and identical corners; at the largest text size corners look squarish.
A.scroll: Smooth flings with no blank rows seen and it reaches the first message, but it takes many flings and the scroll indicator resizes as content heights are measured; one mid-fling frame showed a text-rendering seam.

requirements.note: Right blue / left grey bubbles, oldest at top, date headings like 'Fri, Oct 9 6:40 PM' and 'Today 12:54 AM'; opens at newest message.
Send appends and stays at bottom, composer clears; whitespace-only cannot be sent; trailing newline trimmed.
Composer and separate send button stay above the keyboard; newest messages visible.
Animated dots 'Sam is typing…' row plus 'typing…' nav subtitle; reply ('Perfect') ~2 s later.
Native context menu with Copy/Delete and a correct lifted bubble preview; copy pastes correctly; delete removes and persists.
Scrolling reaches the first message smoothly and a glass chevron 'Jump to newest message' button appears, but tapping it does nothing — the list stays where it is (verified repeatedly).
Sent messages, replies and deletions survive relaunch.

bugs: 'Jump to newest message' button does not scroll: tapping it repeatedly leaves the thread at the same position.
tells: Scroll indicator page count drifts (40 → 45 → 43 pages) while scrolling, indicating estimated heights.
Bubbles have no tails (only a slightly tighter corner), unlike Messages.
B.scroll: Feels like a native list: smooth flings, content blurs under the glass nav bar and composer with the iOS scroll-edge effect, reaches the first message without blank rows; only the indicator length shifts a little.

why: B looks and feels more like a current iPhone app: Liquid Glass send and jump buttons, scroll-edge blur under the bars, large standalone emoji and a correct context-menu preview. Its jump-to-newest button is broken, which is a real functional miss, while A's flaws are cosmetic (blank menu preview, flat hard-clipped bars). On balance B is the one I'd rather polish and ship, but it's close.
